projects.name: Texas solar facility backed by Amazon
projects.quote: We’ve started construction on two new solar facilities, a 200 MW site backed by Amazon in Texas and a 405 MW site backed by Microsoft in Illinois.

projects.name: Illinois solar facility backed by Microsoft

projects.name: ERCOT gas-fueled capacity additions
projects.quote: Announced our intention to add up to 2,000 megawatts of dispatchable, • natural gas-fueled electricity capacity across ERCOT; more than 200 MW of uprates added this quarter.

projects.name: Energy Harbor nuclear fleet acquisition
projects.quote: On March 1, 2024, Vistra closed on the acquisition of Energy Harbor, which added more than 4,000 MW of nuclear generation to its portfolio along with approximately 1 million additional retail customers.
